title: 河道分洪工程
summary: 課程把分洪入口、渠段、收縮、尾水及重匯流視為同一系統，逐步計算流量、比能、臨界水深、波速與泥砂收支，再檢查高程餘量及數值解析度。紅河與元朗是已核對的實際工程背景，所有算例均為原創假設，並非這兩處的操作門檻或斷面設計。
summaryEn: The course treats inlet, channel, contraction, tailwater and rejoining reach as one system, calculating discharge, specific energy, critical depth, wave speed and sediment budgets before checking elevation margins and numerical resolution. Red River and Yuen Long are verified project contexts. All numerical examples are original assumptions rather than their operating thresholds or section designs.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定矩形渠寬20 m、水深2 m及能坡0.0004，只把曼寧糙率由0.030增至0.036 s/m^(1/3)。在這個固定幾何與能坡比較下，流量由37.49降至31.24 m³/s，減少16.67%。這不是說洪水流量固定時水位會同樣減少；若入流必須通過，水深與回水曲線會重新調整。植被、沉積與橋孔還可能同時改變有效幾何，所以實務敏感度應逐項隔離再合併情境，並檢查下游邊界是否仍適用。
workedExample.textEn: Hold rectangular width at 20 m, depth at 2 m and energy slope at 0.0004 while increasing Manning roughness from 0.030 to 0.036 s/m^(1/3). Under this fixed-geometry and fixed-slope comparison, flow falls from 37.49 to 31.24 m³/s, a 16.67% reduction. This does not mean stage falls proportionally when a fixed flood inflow must pass; depth and backwater must then adjust. Vegetation, deposits and bridge openings may also change effective geometry. Practical sensitivity work should isolate those effects before combining scenarios and recheck the receiving boundary throughout. Field observations should distinguish vegetation resistance from an actual reduction of channel area.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」與「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" and "Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分流控制體與受益範圍」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion control volume and effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。局部水位降低可能伴隨上游回水或出口負荷增加，跨區影響不能藏在模型邊界外；分流比例是水位、構造物和支路阻力共同求得的結果，而不是永遠固定的設計百分比。本例只作瞬時水量連續，假設分流節點沒有蓄水或其他支路；不由此推定任何河段水位或可接受的影響分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分流控制體與受益範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. Local stage reduction may accompany upstream backwater or greater outlet loading, and transferred effects must not be hidden outside model boundaries. Diversion fraction emerges from levels, structures and branch resistance rather than remaining a fixed design percentage. The example applies instantaneous continuity without junction storage or other branches. It determines neither reach stages nor an acceptable distribution of impacts. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion control volume and effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分流控制體與受益範圍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion control volume and effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。局部水位降低可能伴隨上游回水或出口負荷增加，跨區影響不能藏在模型邊界外；分流比例是水位、構造物和支路阻力共同求得的結果，而不是永遠固定的設計百分比。
knowledge.textEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. Local stage reduction may accompany upstream backwater or greater outlet loading, and transferred effects must not be hidden outside model boundaries.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。
分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。
所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。
optionsEn: Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach.
Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分流控制體與受益範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion control volume and effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
optionsEn: Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分流控制體與受益範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diversion control volume and effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。把主河、繞道與重匯流區列在同一評估邊界，分別比較水位、流量及受影響土地。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Include the main river, bypass and rejoining area in one assessment boundary, comparing stage, discharge and affected land separately rather than reporting one local benefit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出含重新匯流點的完整控制體，標記每股流量和可能儲水區。說明缺少哪個邊界會讓局部效益被誤認為全流域效益，再檢查合成水量帳。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a complete control volume including the rejoining point, labeling flows and possible storage. Identify a missing boundary that could turn a local benefit into a misleading basin-wide claim, then reconcile the synthetic ledger.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。把主河、繞道與重匯流區列在同一評估邊界，分別比較水位、流量及受影響土地。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Include the main river, bypass and rejoining area in one assessment boundary, comparing stage, discharge and affected land separately rather than reporting one local benefit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出含重新匯流點的完整控制體，標記每股流量和可能儲水區。說明缺少哪個邊界會讓局部效益被誤認為全流域效益，再檢查合成水量帳。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a complete control volume including the rejoining point, labeling flows and possible storage. Identify a missing boundary that could turn a local benefit into a misleading basin-wide claim, then reconcile the synthetic ledger.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification"?
options: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。
optionsEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分流控制體與受益範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion control volume and effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. An unclosed ledger may treat transferred water as flood volume that has disappeared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只作瞬時水量連續，假設分流節點沒有蓄水或其他支路；不由此推定任何河段水位或可接受的影響分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It determines neither reach stages nor an acceptable distribution of impacts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。
knowledge.textEn: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. An unclosed ledger may treat transferred water as flood volume that has disappeared.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口門檻與自由溢流」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inlet threshold and free overflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。堰頂以上水頭的非線性關係，使小幅高程誤差可能明顯改變開始分流的時間與比例；實際側向入口、閘門和回水會偏離簡單正面堰，因此計算式應與入口構型一致。本例為理想正面自由矩形堰並指定係數，不描述紅河或元朗實際入口；不將此算式用作現場閘門操作規則。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口門檻與自由溢流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises. Nonlinear dependence on head above crest means small elevation errors can alter diversion timing and share. Real lateral entrances, gates and backwater differ from a simple frontal weir, so the chosen relation must match the actual inlet configuration. The example is an ideal frontal free rectangular weir with a specified coefficient, not the actual Red River or Yuen Long inlet and not a field gate rule. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inlet threshold and free overflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 關於「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.

steps.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inlet threshold and free overflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Diversion Q=17.0 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口門檻與自由溢流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inlet threshold and free overflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。將模型入口類型、係數及有效長度記錄完整，必要時以實體或三維流場試驗驗證側向進流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence. Document inlet type, coefficient and effective length, using physical or three-dimensional flow testing where lateral approach invalidates a simple frontal-weir representation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出正面與側向入口的差異，為同一指定水頭先做理想計算。再列出側向流、淹沒與閘門會新增的資料需求，避免把手算結果當實際分流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw frontal and lateral inlet differences and perform the ideal calculation at one specified head. List additional information for lateral approach, submergence and gates so that the hand result is not mistaken for actual diversion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把側堰直接當正面堰會忽略沿程水頭變化，門檻高程錯誤也可能造成過早或過晚分流；下游淹沒時沿用自由堰式則通常高估能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a side weir as frontal ignores head variation along its length. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。臨界條件不等於正常水深，也不直接指出上游水面高程；判斷入口或橋孔是否壅水時，還須比較可用能量、局部損失與兩側邊界，不能只靠水深大小分類。
knowledge.textEn: For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. Contraction or bed raising can drive a section toward control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。
速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
optionsEn: Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth.
An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
quiz.explanation: 明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨界水深與控制斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical depth and control sections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Critical depth yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨界水深與控制斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical depth and control sections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。以量測流況、下游控制和局部損失檢查可能的水面分支，避免直接把臨界水深填成全河段水位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum. Check possible water-surface branches against observed regime, downstream control and local losses instead of assigning critical depth as the water level throughout the floodway. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出指定單寬流量的比能曲線，標示可能的兩個水深分支。加入一個底床抬升情境，說明還需要哪些能量資料才能判斷是否發生控制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot specific energy for the given unit discharge and mark the two possible depth branches. Introduce a bed rise and identify the energy information still needed to decide whether choking occurs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨界水深與控制斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical depth and control sections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. Depth above critical at one section does not prove that the entire system remains subcritical. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為寬度固定的矩形渠、靜水壓分布且動能修正係數取一；複合斷面或強三維入口需其他求解。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compound sections or strongly three-dimensional entrances require another solution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。
速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater.
An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
quiz.explanation: 把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證」與「回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification" and "Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收縮速度與能量轉換」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contraction velocity and energy change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。速度水頭增加本身不是摩阻損失，把兩者重複扣除會錯算水面；反之若完全忽略損失，則可能高估可通流量，需要用一致能量線分開表達可逆轉換與耗散。本例只比較動能水頭、兩截面動能修正係數均取一；沒有假定相同底床或已求得水面差，也未包含局部損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收縮速度與能量轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses. Increased velocity head is not itself friction loss, and deducting it twice miscalculates the surface. Ignoring actual loss has the opposite problem, so one energy line must distinguish reversible conversion from dissipation. The example compares kinetic heads with unit energy coefficients only. It does not assume equal bed elevations or determine surface difference, and it excludes local loss. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contraction velocity and energy change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游v1=1.0 m/s、縮口v2=3.0 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，動能水頭增量Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream v1=1.0 m/s, contracted v2=3.0 m/s and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收縮速度與能量轉換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回水曲線與下游控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backwater profiles and downstream control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認座標、底坡與水深定義，從適當邊界逐段求解並隨水深更新摩阻和福祿數。用沿程水位資料檢查曲線，接近臨界或存在水躍時改用可處理轉換的分析而非延長局部直線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth. Compare the profile with longitudinal observations and use transition-capable analysis near critical flow or jumps instead of extending a local straight line. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將局部水深坡度與底坡合成絕對水面坡度，再比較不同福祿數下的分母。說明為何需要逐段更新而不能將一點導數乘整條河長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Combine local depth gradient with bed slope to obtain the absolute surface slope, then compare denominators at different Froude numbers. Explain why reachwise updating is needed instead of multiplying one derivative by the entire channel length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回水曲線與下游控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backwater profiles and downstream control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. Coarse steps near critical flow can further magnify numerical instability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為稜柱渠的局部漸變流導數，正座標沿下游，水深變化不等於絕對水面高程變化；不作長距離定坡外推。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Depth change is not absolute water-surface elevation change, and the slope is not extrapolated over a long reach.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」與「堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" and "Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洪波傳遞與水團速度」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。對寬矩形均勻曼寧流的運動波近似，可得到流速的特定倍數，但回水、擴散與洪泛區儲存會破壞這個簡化；以距離除平均流速直接估警戒時間可能混淆兩種傳遞。本例採寬矩形、固定坡降與糙率的運動波關係c=5V/3，不用於強回水、閘控或急變洪水；不是實際預警提前量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洪波傳遞與水團速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. A wide rectangular uniform Manning channel yields a particular velocity multiple under a kinematic approximation, but backwater, diffusion and floodplain storage break that simplification. Distance divided by mean velocity can therefore confuse parcel and warning travel times. The example uses c=5V/3 for a wide rectangular kinematic Manning channel with fixed slope and roughness, excluding strong backwater, gate control and abrupt flood transitions. It is not an operational warning lead time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設平均流速V=1.5 m/s、長度L=5000 m，運動波c=2.5 m/s，傳遞尺度t=L/c=2000 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume mean velocity V=1.5 m/s and length L=5000 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洪波傳遞與水團速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。

quiz.explanationEn: A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洪波傳遞與水團速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設平均流速V=1.5 m/s、長度L=5000 m，運動波c=2.5 m/s，傳遞尺度t=L/c=2000 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume mean velocity V=1.5 m/s and length L=5000 m. Kinematic celerity c=2.5 m/s gives travel scale t=L/c=2000 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多次洪水的上下游歷線估計傳遞與展寬，檢查是否受到尾水或漫地儲存控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate travel and broadening from upstream/downstream hydrographs across several floods, checking tailwater and overbank storage influence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crest margin and elevation allowances” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons. Declaring complete safety from positive geometric margin overlooks internal erosion, slope instability and foundation problems below overtopping conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分洪泥砂與河床演變」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。長期淤積可能抬高入口或減少渠容，沖刷則可能威脅基礎；泥砂體積帳需要區分固體體積與含孔隙床體積，不能把水量分流比例直接當成泥砂分流比例。本例採均勻床面變化、固定孔隙率與固體體積輸砂率，只表示區段平均沉積；未預測局部沖刷或粒徑分選。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分洪泥砂與河床演變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average. Aggradation can raise the inlet or reduce channel space, while scour threatens foundations. A sediment-volume ledger distinguishes solids from porous bed volume and must not equate water diversion fraction with sediment diversion fraction. The example assumes uniform bed change, fixed porosity and solid-volume transport rates. It gives reach-average deposition only, excluding local scour and size sorting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion sediment and bed evolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證

quiz.question: 關於「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分洪泥砂與河床演變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m. Mean Δz=(Qsin−Qsout)t/[(1−p)BL]=0.0015 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分洪泥砂與河床演變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。檢查入口附近和彎道的局部變化，並讓更新後河床回饋到水理模型，而不是永久固定初始斷面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions. Inspect localized changes near the inlet and bends, and feed the updated bed back into hydraulics instead of retaining the initial channel geometry indefinitely despite sediment evolution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同固體量比較兩種孔隙率的床面升幅，再把沉積集中於入口短段。說明平均高程與局部高程對水理模型有何不同影響，規劃重複測量位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare bed rise at two porosities for the same solid volume, then concentrate deposition in a short inlet reach. Explain how mean and local elevations affect hydraulics differently and choose repeat-survey locations accordingly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉孔隙率會低估沉積床體積，區段平均很小也可能掩蓋入口沙洲；固定河床模型若用於多年規劃，可能高估未來分洪能力或漏掉局部基礎沖刷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting porosity understates deposited bed volume, and a small reach average can conceal an inlet bar. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。檢查入口附近和彎道的局部變化，並讓更新後河床回饋到水理模型，而不是永久固定初始斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions. Inspect localized changes near the inlet and bends, and feed the updated bed back into hydraulics instead of retaining the initial channel geometry indefinitely despite sediment evolution.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用相同固體量比較兩種孔隙率的床面升幅，再把沉積集中於入口短段。說明平均高程與局部高程對水理模型有何不同影響，規劃重複測量位置。
knowledge.textEn: Compare bed rise at two porosities for the same solid volume, then concentrate deposition in a short inlet reach. Explain how mean and local elevations affect hydraulics differently and choose repeat-survey locations accordingly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。
將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.
Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions.
quiz.explanation: 將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分洪泥砂與河床演變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉孔隙率會低估沉積床體積，區段平均很小也可能掩蓋入口沙洲；固定河床模型若用於多年規劃，可能高估未來分洪能力或漏掉局部基礎沖刷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting porosity understates deposited bed volume, and a small reach average can conceal an inlet bar. A fixed-bed model used for long-term planning may overstate future diversion or miss local foundation scour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例採均勻床面變化、固定孔隙率與固體體積輸砂率，只表示區段平均沉積；未預測局部沖刷或粒徑分選。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It gives reach-average deposition only, excluding local scour and size sorting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「非恆定時間步與驗證」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unsteady time step and verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。庫朗數可作顯式淺水波離散的尺度檢查，但不同求解器的穩定與準確條件不同，不能把一個數值當所有軟體保證；網格、時間步和邊界敏感度應與量測驗證一同檢查。本例使用矩形水深的重力波速與順流速度相加，指定目標庫朗數只為示範；隱式求解器或其他格式需依自身文件判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「非恆定時間步與驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flood routing must resolve propagation between cells; a large time step can cause oscillation, numerical diffusion or missed brief control. Courant number offers a scale check for explicit shallow-water discretization, but stability and accuracy differ among solvers. One number is not a universal software guarantee; grid, time-step and boundary sensitivity require checking alongside observations. The example adds rectangular-channel gravity-wave speed to downstream velocity for an illustrative target Courant number. Implicit solvers and other schemes require their own documented criteria. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unsteady time step and verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δx=50 m、V=2 m/s、h=2 m、g=9.81 m/s²、C=0.80，Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δx=50 m, V=2 m/s, h=2 m, g=9.81 m/s² and C=0.80.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「非恆定時間步與驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unsteady time step and verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification" is correct?

洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。

optionsEn: A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions.

quiz.explanationEn: Flood routing must resolve propagation between cells; a large time step can cause oscillation, numerical diffusion or missed brief control. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非恆定時間步與驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unsteady time step and verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δx=50 m、V=2 m/s、h=2 m、g=9.81 m/s²、C=0.80，Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δx=50 m, V=2 m/s, h=2 m, g=9.81 m/s² and C=0.80. Time step Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非恆定時間步與驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unsteady time step and verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。保留水量殘差及局部振盪位置，再用未參與校正的事件驗證，不能只以計算成功結束當作通過。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time. Retain balance residuals and locations of oscillation, then validate against an event excluded from calibration rather than treating successful program completion as proof. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作粗細兩組網格與時間步的比較表，分開列穩定性、守恆與峰值差異。指出哪種差異需要改善數值解析度，哪種可能需要重新調查實際邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare coarse and fine grids and steps, listing stability, conservation and peak differences separately. Identify differences requiring numerical refinement versus those suggesting renewed investigation of the physical boundary conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非恆定時間步與驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unsteady time step and verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. Changing physical roughness merely to achieve numerical stability gives that parameter a false physical interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例使用矩形水深的重力波速與順流速度相加，指定目標庫朗數只為示範；隱式求解器或其他格式需依自身文件判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Implicit solvers and other schemes require their own documented criteria.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
